snippet.title: Pentu Wonderhunter - Ocean Expedition  / Trailer 1
snippet.description:
Pentu Wonderhunter combines the charm of a hand-drawn science storybook with playful point-and-click discovery. Kids explore beautifully animated ocean habitats, meet fascinating creatures, and learn about marine ecosystems. Designed for mobile and tablet play.

made by mitomito Studio
